_about: Human names for game functions identified while debugging. Keys are module offsets (module base: main 0x7110000000, sdk 0x7130000000). 'confidence' is how sure we are; 'evidence' says how it was identified.

0x937a40.name: JobSystem_HelpOrWait_dispatch
0x937a40.evidence: 2026-10-14 thread dumps: main thread and workers 48/49 loop here; jump table over job types (0x937a7c switch), calls the SleepThread wrapper while a job group finishes

0x9386cc.name: JobSystem_WaitGroup_yield
0x9386cc.evidence: atomic increment (ldxr/stxr on [x23]) then bl main+0x2aa4c40 (yield) inside the job wait loop

0x2aa4ab0.name: os_GetCurrentCoreNumber_or_JobSlot
0x2aa4ab0.evidence: called with [main+0x4557a58] word before each job dispatch case; returns an index (cbz/sub 1)

0x2aa4c40.name: os_YieldThread (svc 0xB SleepThread wrapper)
0x2aa4c40.evidence: worker stacks end at sdk svc 0xB stub (sdk+0x158360) via this call

0x863438.name: copy_u64_array_postinc (str x27,[x18],#8 loop)
0x863438.evidence: 2026-10-14 straddled-store crash site; 8-byte store with post-increment

0x9b5d80.name: GameFrame_main_loop_step
0x9b5d80.evidence: frozen-screen diagnosis: main thread frame loop main+0x9b5d80 -> 0x8f6a24 -> 0xae2328 -> 0xf35470 (signals a sync object each frame)
